result_text:
The fix is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in `exportJson()`.

The hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` entries for `all_files.zip` are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. For each aspect it asks `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")` for the name, the same call that wrote the loose file, and reads that file. The entries are in the same order as before, so the default configuration produces the same zip. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is no longer skipped as a side effect of the exception.

`mvn -o -pl reports test -Dtest='DataExporter*'` finished with no output and no surefire reports, so no test matched that pattern. The quiet build suggests the module compiles, but I did not run the export on a renamed config to confirm the zip contents. Nothing is committed.
